Increases DMG taken by enemy targets during this period by **<unbreak>50%</unbreak>**. Additionally, triggering "Shatter" will deal True DMG to all attacked enemy targets and adjacent targets.

buffChoices.name: Evince
buffChoices.desc: During Surging Grit, after allies use their Skill or launch a Follow-Up ATK against enemy targets with "Shatter," "Shatter" can be immediately triggered.

buffChoices.name: Gnosis
buffChoices.desc: During Surging Grit, increases Break DMG taken by enemy targets by **<unbreak>30%</unbreak>**. When targets in the "Shatter" state are defeated by any unit, deals **<unbreak>10</unbreak>** Toughness Reduction regardless of Weakness Type to adjacent enemy targets.

buffChoices.name: Sanity
buffChoices.desc: During Surging Grit, when any character uses their Skill, consumes HP equal to **<unbreak>20%</unbreak>** of their current HP. Additionally, after using Skill, restores HP equal to **<unbreak>20%</unbreak>** of their Max HP.

subBuffs.name: Ultimate Attack
subBuffs.desc: After allies use Ultimate to attack enemy targets, every enemy target hit additionally accumulates **<unbreak>5</unbreak>** Grit Value for allies.

subBuffs.name: Concordant Truce
subBuffs.desc: After an enemy target is defeated by any unit, all allies gain 1 stack of "Resound."

subBuffs.name: Surging Grit
subBuffs.desc: When entering Surging Grit, consume all "Resound." Each stack of "Resound" deals 1 instance of a set amount of DMG to a random enemy target. During Surging Grit, increases enemy targets' DMG taken by **<unbreak>50%</unbreak>**, and after they are defeated by any unit, all allies additionally gain 1 stack of "Resound." When "Resound" stacks up to **<unbreak>10</unbreak>** or higher, consumes all "Resound" stacks and deals 1 instance of a set amount of DMG to a random enemy target per stack.

buffChoices.name: Universality
buffChoices.desc: During Surging Grit, all allies' SPD increases by **<unbreak>40%</unbreak>**. When all "Resound" is consumed in an attack, recover 1 Skill Point.

buffChoices.name: Radiance
buffChoices.desc: During Surging Grit, after an enemy target is defeated by any unit, there is a **<unbreak>50%</unbreak>** chance for all allies to gain 1 stack of "Resound."

buffChoices.name: Potential
buffChoices.desc: When entering Surging Grit, activates the Ultimate of the first character on the team lineup and increases their DMG dealt by Ultimate during Surging Grit by **<unbreak>50%</unbreak>**.

subBuffs.name: Skill Attack
subBuffs.desc: After allies use Skill to attack enemy targets, every enemy target hit additionally accumulates **<unbreak>5</unbreak>** Grit Value for allies.

subBuffs.name: Concordant Truce
subBuffs.desc: At the start of battle, after an ally uses their Skill to attack an enemy target, deals a set amount of DMG to all attacked enemy targets.

subBuffs.name: Surging Grit
subBuffs.desc: Upon entering Surging Grit, advances all allies actions by **<unbreak>100%</unbreak>** and increases DMG received by enemy targets during this period by **<unbreak>50%</unbreak>**. Additionally, after an ally uses their Skill to attack an enemy target, deals an additional set amount of DMG to all attacked enemy targets and adjacent targets.

buffChoices.name: Empty Air
buffChoices.desc: During Surging Grit, all ally Skills do not consume Skill Points. After characters use Skills or Ultimate, they gain 1 stack of "Feverish Surge" for every enemy target hit. These stacks will increase said characters' Skill and Ultimate DMG by **<unbreak>4%</unbreak>** and SPD by **<unbreak>4%</unbreak>** to a max of **<unbreak>10</unbreak>** stack(s).

buffChoices.name: False Promises
buffChoices.desc: During Surging Grit, increases all allies' Follow-Up ATK DMG by **<unbreak>40%</unbreak>**. After triggering a Follow-Up ATK, deals a set amount of DMG to every attacked enemy target and adjacent target.

buffChoices.name: Hollow Hope
buffChoices.desc: During Surging Grit, increases Break DMG received by enemy targets by **<unbreak>30%</unbreak>**. When characters Break enemy targets' Weaknesses, advances the character's action by **<unbreak>12%</unbreak>**.

buff.name: Sharp Words, Blunt Knife
buff.desc: Increases DoT taken by enemy targets by **<unbreak>35%</unbreak>**. Enemy targets that receive DoT have their DMG dealt reduced by **<unbreak>35%</unbreak>**. After they are attacked, their action is Advanced Forward by **<unbreak>35%</unbreak>**.

buffChoices.name: Gimmick
buffChoices.desc:
Increases all allies' Break Effect by **<unbreak>30%</unbreak>**. When Breaking enemy targets, all enemies become afflicted with Wind Shear, taking a set amount of Wind DoT at the start of every turn.
All enemies become immune to Crowd Control debuffs.

buffChoices.name: Drunk Talk
buffChoices.desc: After any ally target uses Ultimate to attack any enemy target and if the target currently has 1/2/3 types of DoTs, each currently active DoT immediately deals DMG equal to **<unbreak>60%</unbreak>** / **<unbreak>100%</unbreak>** / **<unbreak>150%</unbreak>** of the original DMG.

buffChoices.name: Rumor
buffChoices.desc: After allies attack enemies, inflicts Wind Shear on the target, causing the target to take a set amount of Wind DoT at the start of every turn.

buff.name: Whimsicality
buff.desc: When allies Break enemy targets' Weakness, charge Whimsicality. When charged to **<unbreak>6</unbreak>** points, deals a set amount of DMG to random enemies **<unbreak>10</unbreak>** time(s).

buffChoices.name: Arioso
buffChoices.desc: Increases the Break DMG taken by all enemies by **<unbreak>10%</unbreak>**. If allies dealt Super Break DMG to enemies after using an attack, additionally Charges Whimsicality by **<unbreak>1</unbreak>** points.

buffChoices.name: Picturesque
buffChoices.desc: Follow-Up ATK DMG dealt increases by **<unbreak>50%</unbreak>**. Follow-Up ATKs' Weakness Break Efficiency increases by **<unbreak>50%</unbreak>**.

buffChoices.name: Free Writing
buffChoices.desc: When characters launch attacks by using their Ultimate, they will ignore the enemy targets' Weakness to cause Toughness Reduction.

buff.name: Word Shatter
buff.desc: When allies use their Ultimate to attack an enemy target, inflicts the target with Shatter, stacking up to **<unbreak>6</unbreak>** time(s). At the start of the target's turn or when the target is defeated, deals a set amount of DMG to the target and adjacent targets based on the number of Shatter stacks.

buffChoices.name: Rupture
buffChoices.desc: When enemy targets with Shatter are defeated, increases DMG dealt by Ultimate for all allies in this battle by **<unbreak>15%</unbreak>**, stacking up to **<unbreak>20</unbreak>** times.

buffChoices.name: Calumny
buffChoices.desc: Increases DMG dealt with Shatter by **<unbreak>20%</unbreak>**. When triggered, applies 1 stack of Shatter to adjacent targets.

buffChoices.name: Expostulation
buffChoices.desc: When allies' Follow-Up ATKs hit enemy targets, there is a **<unbreak>60%</unbreak>** fixed chance to apply 1 stack of "Shatter" to the target. This effect can only be triggered 1 time per attack per enemy target.

buff.name: Whimsicality
buff.desc: After an ally attacks an enemy target with a Follow-Up ATK, charges "Whimsicality" based on the number of targets attacked. When charged to **<unbreak>10</unbreak>** points, deals a set amount of DMG to random enemy targets **<unbreak>10</unbreak>** time(s).

buffChoices.name: Distortion
buffChoices.desc: Reduces the Charge points required to trigger Whimsicality by **<unbreak>4</unbreak>** and deals DMG **<unbreak>4</unbreak>** more time(s).

buffChoices.name: Chicanery
buffChoices.desc: Increases DMG dealt from allies by Ultimate by **<unbreak>30%</unbreak>**. After the Ultimate is used, Whimsicality additionally gains **<unbreak>2</unbreak>** point(s) of Charge.

buffChoices.name: Exaggerate
buffChoices.desc: After allies attack enemy targets, Whimsicality additionally gains **<unbreak>1</unbreak>** point(s) of Charge.

buff.name: Sharp Words, Blunt Knife
buff.desc: Increases DoT taken by enemy targets by **<unbreak>35%</unbreak>**. Enemy targets that receive DoT have their DMG dealt reduced by **<unbreak>35%</unbreak>**. After they are attacked, their action is Advanced Forward by **<unbreak>35%</unbreak>**.

buffChoices.name: Rebuttal
buffChoices.desc: When enemy targets are defeated, the DoTs on them have a **<unbreak>100%</unbreak>** base chance to be transferred to all enemies.

buffChoices.name: Argument
buffChoices.desc: After enemy targets enter combat, they become afflicted by Wind Shear. At the start of every turn, they receive a set amount of Wind DoT and inflict Wind Shear on themselves and adjacent enemy targets.

buffChoices.name: Verification
buffChoices.desc: When 3 or more characters following the Path of Nihility are in the team, increases all allies' DMG dealt by **<unbreak>60%</unbreak>** and SPD by **<unbreak>30%</unbreak>**.

buff.name: Devious Flattery
buff.desc: Accumulate the amount of DMG dealt by allies' Follow-Up ATKs. When this DMG amount reaches <unbreak>100%</unbreak>, deal a set amount of DMG to all enemies.

buffChoices.name: Examination
buffChoices.desc: "Whimsicality" no longer requires accumulation of DMG dealt by Follow-Up ATK. Instead, it triggers after allies use **<unbreak>3</unbreak>** instances of Follow-Up ATK and the DMG dealt by this effect increases by **<unbreak>60%</unbreak>**.

buffChoices.name: Extrapolation
buffChoices.desc: When the Whimsicality effect is triggered, regenerates Energy for all allies equal to **<unbreak>35%</unbreak>** of their respective Max Energy. Energy recovered via this effect can exceed the ally's Max Energy.

buffChoices.name: Reductio ad Absurdum
buffChoices.desc: Apart from Follow-Up ATKs, all other kinds of DMG dealt by allies can also accumulate progress equal to **<unbreak>18%</unbreak>** of the original DMG amount.

buffChoices.name: Inducement
buffChoices.desc: When allies use a Skill to attack enemy targets, there is a **<unbreak>80%</unbreak>** fixed chance to inflict Shatter to the target.

buffChoices.name: Sympathetic Detonation
buffChoices.desc: When enemy targets use their abilities, inflicts 1 stack of Scalded on them and adjacent units. While in the Scalded state, targets receive **<unbreak>10%</unbreak>** more DMG, stacking up to **<unbreak>3</unbreak>** stack(s). This effect is effective on the set amount of DMG from the Whimsicality effect.

buffChoices.name: Splash
buffChoices.desc: After characters use an Ultimate to attack, their action is Advanced Forward by **<unbreak>25%</unbreak>** and deals **<unbreak>100%</unbreak>** more DMG, lasting for **<unbreak>1</unbreak>** turn(s).

buff.desc: Accumulate the amount of DMG dealt by allies' Follow-Up ATKs. When this DMG amount reaches <unbreak>100%</unbreak>, deal a set amount of DMG to all enemies.

buffChoices.desc: When Ultimate deals DMG to the enemy target, it will be considered as a Follow-Up ATK.

buffChoices.name: Spiel
buffChoices.desc: Whenever a character hits an enemy target with a Follow-Up ATK, all allies' actions are Advanced Forward by **<unbreak>14%</unbreak>**. This effect can only be triggered once for each attack.
